description:
Put a table of amounts per company and per month onto the monthly-pivot card: one row per company with its logo and name, an optional category column, then one column per month. The running month is drawn apart, at the end, marked as in progress.

**This tool measures nothing.** Pass a pivot another tool measured, as it is: for subscriptions, the `pivots` entry of `well_measure_subscriptions` for the currency you drew the trend in. Never build or edit the rows yourself.

The server reads the running month from its own clock, in UTC, and draws the `month_count` complete months before it (12 by default). It resolves each row's company from `company_id`, so the card shows the company's logo and name. A payee the company read cannot reach is drawn from the `name` and `domain` on its row, as the measure returned them. A row with a null `category` is drawn as uncategorised.

REFUSED rather than drawn:
  - more than 50 rows, or two rows for one company
  - an amount keyed outside the drawn months, or keyed by anything but `YYYY-MM`, or a negative amount. A measure that ran just before the month changed is refused on its oldest month: run it again
  - a `company_id` this workspace cannot read and whose row carries no `name` (`success: false` names the ids)
  - a `currency` outside ISO-4217

A month with no amount draws an empty cell, which reads as "no payment", never as zero.

When the token authorizes one workspace, call this directly — no other tool call is needed first. When it authorizes several, this read will not guess which one you mean: pass `workspace_id` on the call.

conversation_id.description: The conversation id returned by the previous Well result, in its meta under well/conversation_id, in its structuredContent, or in its JSON text block. Pass it back on every call in the same conversation, including a call a card makes, so the chosen workspace and the earlier answers still apply. It decides the conversation on its own: nothing the host states about the session replaces it. Omit it only on the first call of a conversation.

currency.description: ISO-4217 code every amount is denominated in. Checked against the catalog, not its shape.

month_count.description: The complete months drawn before the running month. Defaults to 12.

amounts.description: The amount per `YYYY-MM`. A month with no payment has no key.

category.description: The row's category label. `null` is uncategorised.

category_key.description: The category catalog key, when there is one.

company_id.description: The company the row is about. Its logo and name are resolved server-side.

domain.description: The payee's own domain, as the measure returned it. Its logo source when the company cannot be read.

name.description: The payee's own name, as the measure returned it. Used only when the company cannot be read.

rows_truncated.description: True when more rows existed than the measure listed.

show_totals.description: Draw a totals row under the companies.

workspace_id.description: Target workspace. Omit when the token authorizes one workspace. Required when it authorizes several: this read reports one workspace's own figures and will not choose which.

name: well_render_monthly_pivot

conversation_id.description: The conversation this result belongs to. Pass it back as the conversation_id argument on every later Well call in the same conversation.

conversation_id_note.description: Present only when the server opened a fresh lane, stating that no choice recorded earlier was read.

conversation_id_source.description: Where the conversation id came from: the host's own request meta, the caller's argument, or a fresh lane the server opened.

newly_connected.description: Tools that connected to this workspace since the last result and that no session was told about yet, oldest first. Present only when at least one tool is new. Start the reply with one line per entry, in the person's language: "<name> is connected.". Never fold several entries into one sentence. Each entry comes back once, on one result only: never repeat its line later.

resolved_workspace.description: The workspace that answered, when the caller named none and the token authorizes several.

title: Render a monthly pivot
